example-null-reference.title: NullReferenceException
example-null-reference.short: A member was accessed through a null reference
example-null-reference.summary: Dereferencing a value that may be null can cause a runtime exception.
example-null-reference.why: There is no object behind the reference when the member access occurs.
example-null-reference.tips: Make nullable state explicit and guard it before dereferencing.
